module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Deterministic Remainder Ordering During Equity Ties
precondition: Acc 1 and Acc 2 have exact same equity ($10,000.00) and priority.Remainder = 0.01 lot.
expected: System resolves tie deterministically via lower Account_ID or oldest account registration timestamp; zero random behavior.
coverage_note: No configurable remainder-distribution ledger, rebate ledger, or exact block-allocation policy was available for this requirement.
